tagline.zh: Apple iOS 26 全平台统一动态材质:为控件与导航形成独立『功能层』浮在内容之上;regular/clear 两变体,clear 在亮背景上叠 35% 深色 dimming 层。
tagline.en: Apple's unified dynamic material from iOS 26: forms a separate 'functional layer' for controls and nav floating above content; two official variants — regular and clear, the latter stacking a 35% dark dimming layer over bright backdrops.

origin.zh: Apple HIG Materials 官方定义(iOS 26,调研 02 §1 A1;调研 06 §四 §16 与 §六条目18);SwiftUI glassEffect(_:in:) 默认变体 .regular、默认形状 Capsule(A2);Glass.tint(_:) 为可选着色(A3)。Web 复刻仅近似,折射用 SVG feDisplacementMap(仅 Chromium 生效)。
origin.en: Officially defined in Apple HIG Materials (iOS 26, research 02 §1 A1; research 06 §IV §16 and summary item 18); SwiftUI glassEffect(_:in:) defaults to .regular in a Capsule shape (A2); Glass.tint(_:) is optional tinting (A3). Web recreations are approximations; refraction uses SVG feDisplacementMap (Chromium only).

effect.zh: 官方两变体(调研 02 §1 A1 / 06 条目18):regular 模糊背景并调整亮度保文字可读,绝大多数系统组件使用,是 glassEffect 的默认值(A2);clear 高透,仅用于媒体等丰富背景之上的浮动组件。demo 订阅后切换 data-variant——regular 叠白色亮度薄层近似、clear 叠加深色 dimming 层。
effect.en: The two official variants (research 02 §1 A1 / 06 item 18): regular blurs the backdrop and adjusts luminosity for readability — used by most system components and the glassEffect default (A2); clear is highly transparent, reserved for floating controls over rich media. The demo subscribes and toggles data-variant — regular gets a white luminosity veil approximation, clear stacks the dark dimming layer.

effect.zh: clear 变体深色 dimming 层的不透明度;官方建议值 35%(HIG Materials:clear 上底层内容偏亮时加 35% 不透明度的深色 dimming 层,调研 06 §四 §16 与 §六条目18)。regular 的『调整亮度』官方未公布数值,demo 以同值白色薄层近似演示(近似,非官方数值)。
effect.en: Opacity of the clear variant's dark dimming layer; the official recommendation is 35% (HIG Materials: when content under clear is bright, add a 35%-opacity dark dimming layer — research 06 §IV §16 and summary item 18). The luminosity adjustment of regular has no published official number, so the demo approximates it with a white veil of the same value (approximation, not an official figure).

effect.zh: 背景模糊半径。Apple 未公布 Liquid Glass 的具体模糊数值;默认 20px 借用调研 06 §四 §16 记载的经典玻璃配方(glassmorphism.com),作为 Web 近似起点(未证实为 Apple 官方值)。
effect.en: Backdrop blur radius. Apple does not publish Liquid Glass blur numbers; the default 20px borrows the classic glass recipe recorded in research 06 §IV §16 (glassmorphism.com) as the web approximation starting point (not verified as an Apple official value).

effect.zh: 玻璃 tint 着色强度。官方 API Glass.tint(_:) 为可选实例方法(调研 02 §1 A3),默认玻璃不着色——故 0 = 关闭;demo 以蓝色薄层的透明度呈现强度(演示用颜色,非官方值)。
effect.en: Tinting strength of the glass. The official API Glass.tint(_:) is an optional instance method (research 02 §1 A3) and glass ships untinted by default — hence 0 = off; the demo renders strength as the alpha of a blue veil (demo color, not an official value).

note.zh: 官方能力仅 Apple 平台:iOS/iPadOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS 26+ 的 SwiftUI glassEffect / UIKit UIGlassEffect(调研 02 §1 A1–A6)。Web 近似:backdrop-filter 支持 Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9(-webkit- 前缀,调研 02 §4 D2);SVG feDisplacementMap 折射仅在 Chromium 生效(Firefox/Safari 不支持 backdrop-filter 中的 url() 滤镜引用),其余环境回退纯模糊。
note.en: The official capability is Apple-only: SwiftUI glassEffect / UIKit UIGlassEffect on iOS/iPadOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS 26+ (research 02 §1 A1–A6). Web approximation: backdrop-filter works in Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9 (-webkit- prefix, research 02 §4 D2); the SVG feDisplacementMap refraction renders in Chromium only (Firefox/Safari do not support url() filter references inside backdrop-filter) — everything else falls back to pure blur.

fallback.zh: 不支持 SVG 背景折射时,回退『纯模糊 + 1px 内侧高光』近似玻璃感(本 demo 的默认降级路径);不支持 backdrop-filter 时改用较实的半透明表面;非 Apple 26+ 平台本就没有真身,近似是唯一路径。
fallback.en: Without SVG backdrop refraction, fall back to pure blur plus a 1px inner highlight to approximate the glass feel (this demo's default downgrade); without backdrop-filter, use a firmer translucent surface; off Apple 26+ platforms there is no native version at all — approximation is the only path.

use.zh: 浮动控件层:tab bar、工具条、媒体播放控件——官方定位为控件与导航的『功能层』(调研 02 §1 A1)
use.en: Floating control layers: tab bars, toolbars, media transport — officially positioned as the 'functional layer' for controls and nav (research 02 §1 A1)

use.zh: 照片/视频等丰富背景之上的浮动按钮(clear 变体的官方适用场景)
use.en: Floating buttons over photos/videos and other rich backdrops (the official clear-variant use case)

use.zh: 滚动内容之上的常驻操作入口,内容可从其下方穿透滚动
use.en: Persistent entry points over scrolling content, which passes through beneath them

avoid.zh: 内容层:官方明确『不要把 Liquid Glass 用于内容层』(调研 02 §1 A1)
avoid.en: Content layers: Apple explicitly says not to use Liquid Glass for content (research 02 §1 A1)

avoid.zh: 过度使用:官方明确不要滥用;玻璃叠玻璃会让透出层互相发浑
avoid.en: Overuse: Apple warns against it; glass stacked on glass turns muddy

avoid.zh: 正文阅读区与密集数据——半透明材质稀释对比度
avoid.en: Body-reading areas and dense data — translucent materials dilute contrast

avoid.zh: 纯色平面背景——没有可折射/模糊的内容时玻璃感不成立
avoid.en: Flat solid backdrops — with nothing to refract or blur the glass feel collapses

a11y.zh: 玻璃上的文字保持高对比:4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3,调研 06 §五 §17);clear 变体在亮背景上必须按官方建议先叠 35% 深色 dimming 层再放文字;材质不得作为传达关键信息的唯一手段。
a11y.en: Text on the glass keeps high contrast: 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, research 06 §V §17); on bright backdrops the clear variant must stack the official 35% dark dimming layer before placing text; the material must never be the sole carrier of key information.

goal.zh: 复刻一个 Liquid Glass 浮动控件舱:胶囊形状,regular/clear 两变体切换;clear 在亮背景上叠加 35% 深色 dimming 层;Chromium 上用 SVG feDisplacementMap 加折射,其余环境回退纯模糊。
goal.en: Recreate a Liquid Glass floating control cluster: capsule-shaped, switchable between regular and clear; clear stacks the 35% dark dimming layer over bright backdrops; add SVG feDisplacementMap refraction on Chromium with a pure-blur fallback elsewhere.

acceptance.zh: variant 切换 regular/clear,快照默认 regular(官方默认)
acceptance.en: variant toggles regular/clear with the snapshot default regular (the official default)

acceptance.zh: clear 变体深色 dimming 层不透明度严格取 dimming 快照值(默认 35%,HIG 建议)
acceptance.en: The clear variant's dark dimming layer uses the exact dimming snapshot value (default 35%, the HIG recommendation)

acceptance.zh: 折射用 SVG feDisplacementMap:仅 Chromium 启用,其余环境回退纯模糊并如实告知用户
acceptance.en: Refraction via SVG feDisplacementMap: enabled only in Chromium, with an honest pure-blur fallback elsewhere

acceptance.zh: 控件舱保持 Capsule 形状(官方默认形状)+ 1px 内侧高光
acceptance.en: The control cluster keeps a Capsule shape (the official default) plus a 1px inner highlight

acceptance.zh: 文字/图标对比 4.5:1;动效只动 transform/opacity;prefers-reduced-motion 时停用
acceptance.en: Text/icons at 4.5:1; animate only transform/opacity; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
